title: Question 23
passage:
Would it help if I put the changes in a separate note?
A. I checked the mailbox just after lunch. B. The old instructions are still in the folder. C. Yes. Then I won’t have to compare two versions line by line.
passageZh:
如果我把修改事項另寫一張便條，會有幫助嗎？
A. 我午餐後不久就查看了郵箱。 B. 舊版作業說明還放在資料夾裡。 C. 會。那我就不用逐行比對兩個版本了。
